## Description

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include compatibility or migration notes when relevant.

## Related issues

Link relevant issues or requirements. Use `Fixes #...` only when this change resolves the issue completely.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Explain any checks that were not run. For documentation-only changes, describe the link and content checks performed.

## Screenshots

Include before and after screenshots for visible changes, or remove this section.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation, and requirements have been updated.
- [ ] Generated output, reports, credentials, and unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Validation results and any remaining limitations are documented above.
